todo: Copy needs review. The screen is deliberately silent — see the note below.
title: Fake call
lede: Set it up now, and in a minute your phone rings with a reason to walk out. Nobody asks questions about a phone call.
audioNote: This screen makes no sound. A ringtone would need an audio file or the device's audio permissions, and a phone that stays silent is easier to explain than one that rings at the wrong moment. It vibrates instead, if your phone supports that.
armedLabel: Put your phone away. It'll ring.
exitLine: Sorry — I have to take this. I'll message you.
